description: What a certificate says about itself.

fingerprint.description: What a phone pins: SHA-256 over the certificate's DER encoding, lower-case hex.

issuer.description: Who signed it, as an RFC 4514 string, cut where it is too long to show.

issuer_cut.description: Whether the issuer was cut, being too long to show whole.

names.description:
The names it is made out to, its subject alternative names, each whole; those too
many or too long to show, or not written as text, are left out.

names_more.description:
How many of the names it is made out to are left out, being too many or too long to
show, or not written as text.

self_signed.description: Whether it was signed by its own key under its own name.

subject.description: Who it is made out to, as an RFC 4514 string, cut where it is too long to show.

subject_cut.description: Whether the subject was cut, being too long to show whole.
